summary: Continues the current line as far as it is confident. Stays quiet the rest of the time. Read widely, then fine-tuned on the owner's code.
limitations: On code it never trained on, it offers something about 1 time in 9, and about 3 in 4 of those are right. Read what it suggests before you keep it.

provenance.corpus: 6,306 C# files: 8 of the owner's public repositories, plus three MIT-licensed ones, dotnet/wpf at 69805e9, icsharpcode/AvalonEdit at ed0bd14 and MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit at 0877280. No private code. No Microsoft model weights or predictions.

evaluation: 1,500 places where ghost text can appear, from 679 files in 8 private repositories it never trained on: offered 11.0%, right when offered 74.5%, 2.8 wrong per 100 requests, 1.9% of characters saved. Version 2.0.0 on the same cases: offered 12.1%, right 69.2%, 3.7 wrong per 100, 2.0% saved. On AvalonEdit, by other authors, the same recipe trained without it: right 69.5%, 2.0% saved; version 2.0.0: right 51.0%, 1.0% saved.
